title: The Delve Bros - Liveplay of 'Help Me Steal the Mona Lisa'
speaker: The Delve Bros
talk_title: Liveplay of 'Help Me Steal the Mona Lisa'
description:
This talk is from the 2020 virtual Roguelike Celebration:
https://roguelike.club/event2020.html

Eli, Willem, and Zac Delventhal demo their game "Help Me Steal the Mona Lisa" with live audience participation. It is a collaborative game with the audience that is designed for streamers and groups!

The setting? A procedurally generated high tech art museum.
The goal? Steal its most precious work of art without being detected.
The how? I play as the famous art thief, Luc E. Debonair, stealthily moving through the museum. The audience plays as Luc's team of expert hackers, working behind the scenes to map the museum, disable security cameras, distract guards, and generally do everything they can to see Luc through his heist.

Find Eli on Twitter: https://twitter.com/demonpants
The Delve Bros: https://www.delvebros.com/
